display.purpose: Homepage and route headings in the map-first public interface.

headline.purpose: Section headings in the map-first public interface.

shadows.name: map-control-separation
shadows.purpose: Native map controls remain legible above map tiles.

shadows.name: map-marker-separation
shadows.purpose: Circular route markers remain legible above map content.

motion.name: hero-photo-drift
motion.value: scale 1 to 1.075; 16s; infinite repeat; yoyo; sine.inOut
motion.purpose: GSAP gradually closes in on the initial homepage photograph; Photo/Map selection governs playback, and reduced motion pauses it.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Small interactive state transitions; reduced-motion preferences are honored.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main route-finding action with a compact, touch-friendly target.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; border: 1px solid #b04512; border-radius: 8px; background: #c6511b; color: #fff; font: 600 14.5px/1.2 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background .18s, color .18s, border-color .18s, transform .18s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #a23f10; border-color: #a23f10; transform: none; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9622a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { opacity: .82; }

components.name: Route Search Field
components.description: Place search used to find routes from the homepage.
components.html: <input class="ds-search-field" type="search" placeholder="Search by place" aria-label="Search by place">
components.css: .ds-search-field { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 12px 10px 41px; border: 1px solid #7b887c; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #12294a; font: 400 16px/1.4 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9622a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Compact public navigation over a white surface.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 9px 16px; background: #fff; color: #46556d; font: 500 14px/1.4 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #12294a; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9622a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Route Card
components.description: Compact route summary with a photo, map preview and practical facts.
components.css: .ds-route-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dce1d8; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #12294a; } .ds-route-card:hover { border-color: #6f8156; } .ds-route-card-media { min-height: 120px; background: #e8eddf; } .ds-route-card-body { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 15px; font: 400 13px/1.45 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-route-card-body strong { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-route-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #d9622a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Photo and Map Selector
components.description: Explicitly selects the homepage photo or real route map in the same frame.
components.css: .ds-preview-select { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #bec8ba; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; } .ds-preview-select button { min-width: 64px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 6px; color: #12294a; font: 700 14px/1.2 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-preview-select button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #12294a; color: #fff; } .ds-preview-select button:hover { background-color: #e9ede5; } .ds-preview-select button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9622a; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Naarad's public surfaces pair a clear route-finding workspace with the warmth of an India travel guide. Light paper-like neutral grounds and navy text keep route facts legible; orange marks actions and sage quietly supports map-related detail. Real licensed place imagery gives routes a sense of place without taking over the task of comparing walks.

The interface is compact and practical, with visible control boundaries, straightforward dividers and a restrained radius vocabulary. The homepage brings a real Hampi photograph and an explicitly selected route-map preview together in one frame; the map catalogue gives results and map equal working importance. Motion is limited and user-controllable, and reduced-motion behavior is respected.
keyCharacteristics: Map and route facts lead the discovery experience.
Warm, low-chroma surfaces support navy text and orange actions.
Compact sans-serif controls use clear boundaries and touch-friendly heights.
Photography is factual and credited; map previews use a quiet sage ground.

rules.name: The Route-Facts Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep route facts on light neutral surfaces with the dark ink palette; reserve orange text for its contrast-safe text role.

rules.name: The Map-First Sans Rule
rules.body: Use DM Sans for homepage, catalogue and route headings and interface text; long-form story surfaces retain their serif reading typography.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: Keep route and collection cards shadow-free and stationary; use a border-color shift to mark hover.

dos: Do keep search and route facts close to the map they help visitors interpret.
Do use the compact control scale and maintain 44px minimum control heights.
Do keep map interaction native and preserve the explicit photo/map selection.
Do use credited, existing place imagery and honest route facts.
donts: Don't add resting shadows or lift to route and collection cards.
Don't make the route map compete with decorative scroll effects.
Don't use orange text as though it were the solid action-fill token.
